title: Runtime State & Event Foundation
scope: Central Jarvis runtime lifecycle, orthogonal state projection, sequenced in-memory event replay, reconnect snapshots, explicit intelligence-provider routing, non-secret runtime settings, bounded provider health, and accepted Voice Lab runtime hosting
focused_test_command: python -m unittest tests.unit.test_event_bus tests.unit.test_0_0_6_runtime_settings tests.unit.test_0_0_6_provider_router tests.unit.test_0_0_6_runtime_health tests.integration.test_0_0_6_runtime_foundation tests.unit.test_0_0_6_voice_lab_runtime_wiring -v

accepted_voice_path.stt: Silero v6.2 speech presence + whisper.cpp large-v3-turbo-q5_0 rolling partial/final validation
accepted_voice_path.intelligence: OpenAI GPT-6 Luna reasoning=none service_tier=default persistent websocket continuation
accepted_voice_path.tts: Qwen3 streaming candidate / whole-response / fixed-seed accepted path
accepted_voice_path.speech_validation: multi-signal confidence; no keyword fast paths

runtime_invariants: runtime lifecycle, runtime health, voice presence, and conversation activity are separate axes
provider and transport events do not directly become authoritative product state
event replay is bounded and memory-only in 0.0.6
stale replay cursors report a gap rather than silently dropping history
provider routes are explicit and never silently change model or service tier
provider health probes are concurrent and timeout bounded
runtime snapshots expose non-secret orchestration settings only
known_limitations: local HTTP/WebSocket client transport and desktop process supervision are deferred
event replay is in-process memory only; a process restart begins a new runtime cursor
durable/redacted event persistence is deferred to a dedicated boundary
automatic provider/model escalation or fallback is not enabled
tools, memory persistence, autonomous jobs, and new working/researching/error modes are deferred
fuzzy or phonetic wake-word correction such as Jervis to Jarvis is deferred
